in_marathi.name: Akansh
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Desire, Wish, Hope
in_marathi.long_meaning: Akansh हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Akansh is a Sanskrit name derived from the Sanskrit word 'akarshana', which means 'desire' or 'wish'. It is believed that the name Akansh symbolizes the deepest desires and hopes of a person. In Hindu mythology, it is associated with the god Vishnu, who is believed to fulfill the deepest desires and wishes of his devotees.
